'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****[[Russia]]n military sources claim that [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] forces have destroyed or damaged all three bridges over the [[Seym (river)|Seym river]] in western Russia, potentially trapping [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] between the river, the [[Russia–Ukraine border|Ukrainian border]], and advancing [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian forces]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-russia-0701b3c7f51d1dd1b6e74390f2201339 (AP)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Pokrovsk offensive]], [[Battle of Toretsk]]
****Russia claims that its forces have taken control of the settlement of [[New York, Ukraine|New York]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-military-says-it-takes-control-strategic-ukrainian-town-niu-york-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)]
****Ukraine says that Russian forces are launching heavy attacks on the [[Toretsk]] and [[Pokrovsk, Ukraine|Pokrovsk]] fronts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kyiv-says-its-forces-under-heavy-russian-attack-east-ukraine-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Ternopil]] residents are urged to remain indoors after Russian drone strikes an industrial facility, causing a large fire and an increased concentration of [[chlorine]] in the air. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/people-ukraines-ternopil-urged-stay-inside-after-large-fire-breaks-out-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)] [https://kyivindependent.com/higher-chlorine-air-concentration-in-ternopil/ (''The Kyiv Indepenent'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] recover the bodies of six hostages who were kidnapped by [[Hamas]] in the initial [[2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel|October 7, 2023 attack]], including [[Alex Dancyg]], from the [[Khan Younis]] area in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-retrieves-bodies-six-hostages-held-gaza-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least twelve [[Palestinian]]s, including two children, are killed in an Israeli [[airstrike]] on a school used to shelter [[displaced people]] in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/israel-air-strike-mustafa-hafez-school-gaza-city-kills (Middle East Eye)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches airstrikes on the [[Hezbollah]] stronghold of [[Baalbek]] in the [[Beqaa Valley]] in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-08-20/ty-article-live/aoc-at-dnc-kamala-harris-is-working-tirelessly-to-secure-gaza-cease-fire-hostage-release/00000191-6d8d-d5f6-abf9-ef8d5d8b0000 (Haaretz)]
**Four people are killed and two others are injured by [[Israel]]i strikes in [[Daraya, Chouf|Daraya]], [[Mount Lebanon Governorate]], Lebanon, according to the Lebanese Health Ministry. In response, Hezbollah launches [[drone warfare|55 drone strikes]] on 3 IDF positions in the Israeli-occupied [[Golan Heights]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2568221/middle-east (Arab News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 20 bodies are recovered from the [[Lukenie River]] in [[Mai-Ndombe Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], following the capsizing of a boat carrying around 300 passengers over the weekend. At least 46 people are rescued and about 250 others remain missing. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-accident-lukeni-overloading-3d3bd5346fdde0beaa5c60a67c18a7d3 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**The [[Ivory Coast]] reports 21 new cases of [[mpox]] as well as the country's first death from mpox. [https://www.lapresse.ca/international/afrique/2024-08-20/cote-d-ivoire/28-cas-de-mpox-recenses-dont-un-mort.php (''La Presse'')]
**A [[Liberia]]-flagged ship on the [[Paraná River]] near [[Rosario]], [[Argentina]], is [[quarantined]] after suspected cases of mpox are detected on the ship. The [[Argentine Health Ministry]] subsequently activates an emergency protocol against mpox. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ship-argentinas-parana-river-is-quarantined-suspected-mpox-case-local-media-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/20/americas/argentina-quarantines-mpox-ship-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Malawi]] declares mpox a public health emergency, following growing concerns and a reported probable case of mpox in the country. [http://mbc.mw/malawi-declares-mpox-a-public-health-concern/ (MBC Malawi)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Azerbaijan–Russia relations]]
**[[Azerbaijan]] formally applies to join the [[BRICS]] [[Trade bloc|economic bloc]] following a meeting between [[President of Azerbaijan|President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] and [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] in [[Baku]], Azerbaijan. Aliyev also approves US$120 million to expand [[Azerbaijan–Russia relations|Russian–Azerbaijani]] [[Cargo|cargo trade]]. [https://apnews.com/article/azerbaijan-russia-china-brics-putin-e4f31a0b06bef96cc329e88058c35dfd (AP)]
*[[Germany–Iran relations]]
**Following the ordered closure of the [[Islamic Centre Hamburg]] in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]], [[Iran]] orders the closure of two branches of a [[German (language)|German]] language school in [[Tehran]] for "breaching Iranian law, committing various illegal actions and extensive financial violations." In response, Germany summons the [[List of ambassadors of Iran to Germany|Iranian ambassador]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-orders-closure-of-german-language-institute-in-tehran/a-69994587 (DW)]
*[[Haiti–United States relations]], [[Illegal drug trade in Haiti]]
**The [[United States Treasury Department]] imposes sanctions on musician and former [[Haitian President]] [[Michel Joseph Martelly]] for allegedly using his influence to facilitate [[drug trafficking]] in the country as well as into the [[United States]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/20/us-sanctions-former-haitian-president-over-alleged-drug-trafficking (Al Jazeera)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**A [[North Korea]]n [[Korean People's Army|staff sergeant]] [[North Korean defectors|defects]] to [[South Korea]] after crossing the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]] into [[Goseong County, Gangwon]], and is taken into South Korean custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korean-soldier-defects-south-yonhap-reports-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war protests in the United States]]
**Several pro-[[Palestinian]] demonstrators are arrested after protestors clashed with police near the [[List of consuls general of Israel to the United States#Consulate (Chicago)|Israeli consulate]] in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]], on the second night of the [[2024 Democratic National Convention|Democratic National Convention]]. [https://apnews.com/article/democratic-convention-chicago-protests-war-gaza-f064683535bbbe93231d31ecc2dbafc7?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]
*[[Law of Ukraine "On the Protection of the Constitutional Order in the Field of Activities of Religious Organizations"]]
**[[Verkhovna Rada|Ukrainian lawmakers]] pass a bill to ban the activities of all [[Russia]]-associated religious groups across [[Ukraine]], including the [[Ukrainian Orthodox Church (Moscow Patriarchate)|Ukrainian Orthodox Church]], following arrests of dozens of the church's [[Clergy|clerics]] on [[treason]] charges for alleged involvement in Russian [[espionage]] and the transfer of a cleric to Russia in a [[Prisoner exchange|prisoner swap]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-adopts-law-paving-way-ban-russia-linked-minority-church-2024-08-20/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-parliament-legislative-ban-ukrainian-orthodox-church-539e0f3a6d657277aa4fa93b8ec53505 (AP)]
*Suspected [[serial killer]] Collins Jumaisi Khalusha, accused of murdering 42 women, escapes from [[Kenya Police|police]] custody in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/20/suspected-serial-killer-escapes-from-police-custody-in-kenyas-nairobi (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Taliban]]'s [[Ministry for the Propagation of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice (Afghanistan)|virtue ministry]] dismisses 281 members of the [[Afghan National Security Force|security force]] for failing to grow a beard and announces that they also destroyed 21,328 musical instruments in the past year and prevented thousands of computer operators from selling "immoral and unethical" films in markets. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/08/20/taliban-morality-police-dismiss-over-280-men-without-beards-from-security-forces (Al Arabiya)]
